Our story

Built on craft, rooted in family

Stone Aspen is a second-generation, family-owned custom home builder with 60+ years of experience crafting fine homes across Colorado's Front Range. David Putnam, a construction executive with 40+ years of residential building, founded the company on a simple principle: without great design and craftsmanship, there is no reason to build. The firm intentionally stays small—a deliberate choice that ensures every homeowner receives direct access to David, Brian, and the team throughout the entire process.

A closer look.

Good to know

Questions, answered.

What makes Stone Aspen different from larger builders?

Stone Aspen chooses to stay small. As a family-owned builder, you get unparalleled access to Owner David Putnam and the entire team throughout your project. Larger builders simply cannot offer this level of direct involvement and personalized attention.

How does Stone Aspen approach design?

Our projects reflect modern lifestyles with extensive use of windows to maximize views and natural light. We emphasize simplicity, texture, and natural materials. You determine your architectural style; we help you realize it with intelligent design that respects the landscape and your essential needs.

What does the homebuilding process look like?

We provide end-to-end project management and design development services. Our approach combines careful planning and preparation with expert trade partners to ensure projects run smoothly, stay on schedule, and remain within budget.

What areas do you serve?

We're based in Castle Rock, Colorado, and build custom homes in Castle Rock, Sedalia, Parker, Franktown, Elizabeth, Larkspur, and Monument—primarily Douglas County and portions of Elbert and El Paso counties.

How do you define craftsmanship?

Craftsmanship is the quality that comes from building with passion, care, and attention to detail. It's a precise skill honed over a career. Without great craftsmanship, we don't build. That's our standard.

Can you help if we don't have land yet?

Yes. We offer Legacy Pines in Franktown—29 estate lots ranging from 2.7 to 6.8 acres with 120 acres of open space, just 10 minutes from Castle Rock and Parker. We also work with buyers to find sites across our service areas.
